newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea Flour seeks 15,400 tonnes of U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Korea Flour seeks 15,400 tonnes of U.S. wheat.

text.p: Korea Flour Milling Corp on Tuesday invited tenders for 15,400 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat by 3:00 p.m. (0600 GMT), traders said.
Shipment was slated for March 10 to April 10 from the Pacific Northwest to the western port city of Mokpo, traders said.

They said the company is seeking for 6,000 tonnes of soft white wheat (maximum protein 10.0 percent), 3,500 tonnes of soft white (Maximum protein 9.5 percent), 2,300 tonnes of hard red winter (HRW), and 3,600 tonnes of dark northern spring (DNS).
